tickets.title: Structured failure fingerprints + base-vs-candidate differential classifier
acceptance: Gate output parsed to {suite, test, file, line, errorClass} rows with volatile values (timestamps, ports, tmp paths, durations) normalized before comparison

Deterministic classifier: base green + candidate red = regression (consumes attempt); identical red fingerprints = blocked_on_baseline (consumes none, candidate preserved); mixed = only NEW failures charged; base red + candidate green = flagged for explicit review, never silently absorbed
Model prose can never override the classification — the classifier is pure code with table-driven tests covering all four rows

Wired: baseline cache stores rows + CURRENT.json pointer (scope WIDENED to baseline.mjs — unowned, needed for the base half); gates.mjs computes+logs the differential on receipt failure; ticket.mjs breaks the ladder on blocked_on_baseline (zero charge, branch preserved) and on mixed sends the coder ONLY the NEW rows. 11 new tests incl. the volatile-noise twin-match hazard. Full gate 4832 green (first run failed eslint no-control-regex — fixed via charCode-built ANSI_RE, re-gated).

DRIVE step: runs the conductor as a child process with a bounded --max-tickets per iteration (injected in tests); budgets per the goal-skill contract: iteration cap (default 5) and a NO-PROGRESS HALT when the gap fingerprint set is byte-identical to the previous iteration (the run-coverage-loop exit-3 rule) — escalation report names the stuck requirements
The loop writes docs/work/requirement-ledger.json each iteration (self-documenting progress: per-requirement status uncovered/coded-not-done/done + iteration history)

Pure core with injected ports (readSources, board IO, runConductor, mintVerifyReceipt, seamResults, testExists) — table-driven tests: exit-on-pass, gap-to-proposal per class, no-progress halt, iteration cap, proposals honor the risk tier; CLI wrapper scripts/product-loop.mjs wires real implementations
